changes.summary: The AFL Free Agents page was hiding every player still rostered in the OTHER conference — so a guy dropped in your conference (looking at you, Kyle Pitts) never showed up as available. Availability is now tracked per conference, complete with an 'FA in AL/NL' tag, and roster moves now hit the page within a minute of happening on MFL instead of waiting for the next site deploy.

NFL team logos no longer show up as broken-image icons in dark mode on spotty connections — the site now serves its own copies of the dark logo set instead of leaning on ESPN's servers every time a page renders.
